audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Maokai for rows 2, 3, 5 and 6 and Skill for row 6-level... specifically: rows 2-3 said Maokai while their own whys say 'tightens to a skill matchup' and 'the lane sits even until 6'; rows 4-6 said Skill/Maokai/Maokai while whys[4] says the free-kill window is gone, whys[5] says his scaling overtakes you, and whys[6] says 'you out-scale nothing here'. The packet levelChart is Maokai, Maokai, Skill, Skill, Kassadin, Kassadin, Kassadin.
audit.why: The mirror agent recorded being 'BLOCKED BY THE LENGTH BAND' on exactly these rows. That belief is false — side and rating are ENUM_FIELDs and are exempt (apply-proposals.js:78). This is the whole reason the chart shipped wrong.
audit.corrected: Rows 2-6 set to the packet chart in BOTH layers, proposed as one atomic paired group, with ratings moved to match (5/10, 5/10, 4/10, 4/10, 3/10) and every affected phases[N].why rewritten so the prose no longer argues against the row.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike framing was generic ('Heartsteel is your spike') and ignored that Kassadin's spike ordering is the entire matchup.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s and 40 mana; Null Sphere is 9/8.5/8/7.5/7s with a magic shield; your W is 14/13/12/11/10s. Pre-6 he is a blinkless melee; post-6 no root holds him.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into tldr, winCon, phases[1].why, phases[3].why, phases[4].why, phases[5].why, dosFull[0].d and the All-In Windows block.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page told you to 'engage on Riftwalk's cooldown' and to 'track Riftwalk before every commit'. Riftwalk's cooldown is 5s at rank 1 and 2s at rank 3 — there is no cooldown window to trade in. The advice was structurally impossible to follow.
audit.why: The template assumed the enemy's key ability is a long-cooldown answer. Here it is a near-permanent blink, so the correct framing is a hard pre-6 timer, not a cooldown watch. Also unstated: Null Sphere interrupts channels and grants a magic-damage shield, which is what blunts Sap Magic trades from level 3 on.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, All-In Windows, dosFull[0].d and Key Ability Interactions rewritten around 'kill him before 6' plus the Null Sphere shield/interrupt.
